rationale: Tests recall of the core concept of selective toxicity introduced in the content block on 'Why Antimicrobials Are Different'.
Tests understanding of the key metric used by Antibiotic Stewardship Programmes to track prescribing volume, covered in the Antibiotic Stewardship in Practice block.
Tests recall of the mechanism shared by all beta-lactam antibiotics, from the Cell-Wall Inhibitors content block.
Tests application of knowledge about fluoroquinolone mechanism from the DNA/Metabolic Pathway Inhibitors block.
Tests application of the UTI classification and treatment framework — specifically nitrofurantoin's limitation in pyelonephritis.
Tests understanding of partner treatment in STD management, from the STD Treatment Plans block.
Tests recall of the mechanisms of the four first-line ATT drugs (HRZE) from the First-Line Anti-Tuberculosis Drugs content block.
Tests application of MDR-TB treatment knowledge, from the Treatment Regimens block on drug-resistant TB.
Tests understanding of WHO MDT regimen differences between paucibacillary and multibacillary leprosy from the WHO MDT Regimens block.
Tests the critical rule about continuing MDT during lepra reactions, covered in the Lepra Reactions block.
Tests application of the two-drug sequential strategy for amoebiasis from the Amoebiasis Pharmacotherapy block.
Tests understanding of why primaquine requires G6PD testing before use in malaria treatment, from the Malaria Pharmacotherapy block.
Tests understanding of the mechanism and major toxicity of amphotericin B from the Polyenes and Azoles content block.
Tests application of the critical clinical rule about voriconazole and mucormycosis from the Echinocandins and Other Antifungals block.
Tests recall of albendazole's mechanism from the Benzimidazoles, Pyrantel, and Ivermectin content block.
Tests understanding of the requirement for steroids when treating neurocysticercosis with praziquantel, from the Praziquantel and Other Anthelmintics block.
Tests understanding of aciclovir's selective activation mechanism from the Anti-Herpetic and Anti-Influenza Drugs block.
Tests application of ART initiation guidelines from the Antiretroviral Therapy block — specifically the current recommendation to start ART regardless of CD4 count.
Tests application of alkylating agent mechanisms and toxicities from the Alkylating Agents and Antimetabolites block.
Tests understanding of vincristine's unique toxicity profile (neurotoxic but not myelosuppressive) from the Plant Alkaloids and Targeted Agents block.
